answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 7433 Country: India Title: I am doing job in UAE.before two year my marrige was done . before 1 and 1/2 year living alone in UAE. my wife in india. my salary is also less i cant afford to family with me. please reply me what can i do? Question: salaam alaikum o rahmatullah. I am doing job in UAE.before two year my marrige was done . before 1 and 1/2 year living alone in UAE. my wife in india. my salary is also less i cant afford to family with me. please reply me what can i do? Answer ID: 7433 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1488/1403=D/1429) It is not good to be away for so long from your wife; there may be many evils. You should keep your wife with you. If it is not possible, you should adopt any income source in India and keep your wife with you. Also, you should keep on reciting these duas : ربناهب لنا من ازواجنا وذريتنا قرة اعين واجعلنا للمقيمن اماما اللهم اصلح لى فى ذريتى Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
